main_text.l: Regerit R. Iehuda; imò circa Siclos de-
lummodò. Respondit R. Simeon, Etiamsi res ita se
habet, tamen semper idem omnes [pro si-
sicli erunt;] At pro peccato unus solvit
profanum est. Residuum (8) decimæ partis Ephæ,

page.notes: The visible part is cut at the right, so the line ends of the Hebrew and the Latin are missing. Hebrew readings are approximate because the strip is faint and partly obscured by stains. Latin fragments are copied as far as legible; the line breaks of the Latin block are not reproduced exactly. Nothing printed in the margins is visible. Left part of the page is cut off; the Hebrew characters on the left are only partly legible and are not reproduced. Some words at the edges are uncertain.
